text:
lina: Hey team — noticed a p99 jump on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate around 08:02 UTC. p50 looks flat, p95 up ~20ms, p99 up ~120ms. Any chance routing/queueing changes yesterday are leaking into percentiles?

mike: ugh saw that. We did flip a small routing weight for EU->dedicated yesterday morning. Doesn't fully explain p99 though.

sangeet: can you paste the dashboard slice? is this across all clients or one tenant?

lina: attaching console view (screenshot pasted) — spike concentrated on client_tag: mobile-ios and queue=high-priority.

ashley: mobile-ios got a traffic bump from the new home feed canary. Could be queuing at the gateway.

mike: two hypotheses: 1) queue_time included in service_time metric for backend aggregation (so percentiles mix queue+proc), 2) sample origin changed (some routes now include proxy hops).

lina: yeah that's my worry — the percentile contract in the console promises "service_time" p50/p95/p99 of the endpoint, but we never clearly documented whether it includes pre-dispatch queue.

devx: short term: can we split the viz by `queue_time_bucket` and `kvcache_hit`? that should show if queueing dominates tail.

mike: query we ran: `SELECT approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) FROM samples WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND client_tag='mobile-ios' GROUP BY queue` — results show high-priority queue p99 = 420ms vs normal 310ms.

paul: is that raw samples or tdigest rollup? big difference if tdigest rollups across shards.

mike: raw samples (we pulled from sample_store for that 15m window).

ashley: ok so queue impact is real. But still odd p50 unchanged. Means only a small fraction of requests are getting large queue times — classic head-of-line or burst queueing.

sangeet: question for telemetry folks: do we tag `sample_origin` (gateway|proxy|backend) on all spans? if not, we should. right now dashboard aggregation loses origin and we can't filter.

ops-bot: Note: autoscaler event at 07:58 UTC — scaled +2 dedicated workers in eu-west-1.

lina: thanks ops-bot — scaling after the spike suggests capacity knee. Could be transient.

devx: UX ask: add a tiny toggle on the latency pane: "include queue time" default off, with hover explaining what counts. That avoids surprising customers about what p99 measures.

paul: agree on toggle. Also we must update API docs: "latency metrics represent X and Y; queue time included only when `include_queue=true` or when sample_origin=gateway".

mike: engineering note: our internal metric `service_time_ms` is currently emitted at gateway as `gateway_total_ms` and at backend as `backend_proc_ms`. The console was plotting `service_time_ms` without origin tag. we can fix dashboard to rollup `backend_proc_ms` by default.

ashley: runtime-wise, changing default to backend_proc_ms is safe, but some product folks rely on gateway_total_ms for SLOs. we need a migration path.

lina: can we add a legend badge that shows which metric is being used (gateway_total / backend_proc / combined) and make it clickable to switch? Small UX but big clarity win.

sangeet: from infra side I can add `sample_origin` and `queue_time_ms` to the sample schema, but that needs a migration announcement. I'll open a repo PR today.

devx: once we have sample_origin, console can surface a provenance pill like "origin: gateway" next to percentiles. Also expose a raw-sample viewer link so SEs can confirm tail cases.

paul: for short term alerting: create a runbook step to check queue_time_histogram whenever route p99 > baseline + X. saves paged noise.

lina: action items: 1) sangeet add telemetry fields (sample_origin, queue_time_ms) — PR by EOD. 2) mike update dashboard to default to backend_proc_ms and add metric legend (canary). 3) devx mock UX toggle and provenance pill. 4) paul add alert runbook snippet. I'll follow up in thread.

mike: I'll push a small query patch now to show backend_proc_ms p99 vs gateway_total_ms p99 for that window and post results.

ashley: tagging @growth-product for visibility — this affects mobile canary metrics.

devx: small note: include unit tests for the dashboard toggle behavior (switching metric should preserve time range and aggregation).

lina: thanks all — appreciate quick triage. I'll mark this for follow-up in the console UX board. :thumbsup:
